modules.title: Orientation: Your First SOC Shift
modules.description: You join the CDAC Bengaluru SOC learning environment. Mentor Ananya, an experienced L1 analyst, explains the shift, learning path, lab safety and how to ask for help.
learningObjectives: Master core principles of Orientation: Your First SOC Shift in the CDAC Bengaluru learning setting.
Learn with mentor Ananya (Experienced L1 Analyst).
Understand theoretical frameworks and complete practical exercises.
Complete unit assessments and hands-on lab requirements.

modules.title: Computer Fundamentals

learningObjectives: Master core principles of Computer Fundamentals in the CDAC Bengaluru learning setting.

Complete unit assessments and hands-on lab requirements.

modules.title: Networking Fundamentals
modules.description: Mentor Ravi walks you through a small CDAC Bengaluru branch network, from a staff laptop to the local switch, gateway, DNS and an internal service.

modules.title: SOC Operations & Alert Triage
